scenario.title: Doctrine: Grace and Matter
scenario.premise: Across eight desks, build and question arguments about evil, freedom, bodies and grace. Manuscripts answer other manuscripts; agreement is not the same as victory. A completed argument reconstructs its author’s position, not a proof of belief.

stage.title: What can reach the spirit?
stage.speaker: The Lyon ritual · a separate medieval witness
stage.motivation: A candidate is asked to receive spiritual baptism and undertake a demanding life. The Lyon ritual gives the book, hands and apostolic passages concrete roles. Its claim must also be distinguished from the earlier dispute over the world’s origins.

objectives.text: Explain Lyon’s appeal to apostolic spiritual baptism
Explain why Lyon’s spiritual baptism is still bodily
